about_page.title: About UFO LABZ
about_page.subtitle: Alien performance technology. Swiss scientific precision.
about_page.hero_title: BUILT BY ATHLETES. ENGINEERED FOR ANOTHER WORLD.
about_page.hero_subtitle: UFO LABZ was founded on an uncompromising vision: elite sports nutrition supplements engineered by and for athletes seeking superior physical performance.
about_page.story_p1: The supplement industry is filled with opaque proprietary blends and underdosed ingredients. We created UFO LABZ to offer a flawless Swiss alternative: 100% transparency, clinical dosages, and independent laboratory testing.
about_page.story_p2: The alien performance identity is not just branding: it reflects our drive to push far beyond standard industry conventions to design the highest-quality supplements on earth.
about_page.std1_desc: Every batch is independently verified for purity, potency, and the absolute absence of heavy metals or contaminants.
about_page.std2_desc: Zero proprietary blends. Every active ingredient is dosed at levels backed by sports nutrition research.
about_page.std3_desc: Formulated and manufactured under strict GMP and HACCP certifications in the heart of Switzerland.
about_page.std4_desc: Our formulas are shaped and continuously tested by elite athletes and competitive bodybuilders.
about_page.mission_text: Develop the purest, most effective, and fully transparent nutritional supplements in the world, with zero compromises on clinical dosage.
about_page.swiss_roots_text: All our formulations are designed, tested, and packaged according to Switzerland's most rigorous manufacturing standards.

faq_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq_page.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our formulas, Batch 01 pre-orders, delivery, and Swiss standards.
faq_page.a_shipping_time: Standard shipping in Switzerland takes 2 to 3 business days via Swiss Post. In Europe, delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
faq_page.a_intl_shipping: Yes! We ship across Switzerland (free above CHF 75) and to all European Union countries (free above €50).
faq_page.q_track_order: How can I track my order?
faq_page.a_track_order: As soon as your package ships, you will receive a tracking number via email to follow delivery in real time.
faq_page.q_lab_testing: Are your formulas third-party lab tested?
faq_page.a_lab_testing: Yes, 100%. Every production batch undergoes microbiological and purity analysis in accredited Swiss laboratories.
faq_page.a_vegan: Most of our line (Creatine pure, fermented EAAs, Magnesium bisglycinate) is 100% vegan. Only our Collagen peptides originate from marine sources.
faq_page.a_what_makes_diff: Swiss precision engineering, transparent clinical dosages without proprietary blends, and pharmaceutical-grade purity.
faq_page.q_payment_methods: What payment methods do you accept?
faq_page.a_payment_methods: We accept credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay), TWINT for Swiss customers, and SEPA bank transfers.
faq_page.q_preorder_cancel: Can I cancel my Batch 01 pre-order?
faq_page.a_preorder_cancel: Yes, at any time prior to shipment dispatch. We issue an instant 100% full refund with zero cancellation fees.
faq_page.a_preorder_dispatch: Batch 01 dispatches will commence in the second week of December 2026 directly from our facility in Switzerland.

preorder_page.title: PRE-ORDER TERMS & GUARANTEE
preorder_page.subtitle: All UFO LABZ nutritional formulations are produced under sterile laboratory standards in Switzerland. Learn how our batch pre-order model protects you with a 100% risk-free guarantee.
preorder_page.box_desc: You may modify or cancel your pre-order reservation at any time prior to shipment for an instant 100% refund to your original payment method (Card or TWINT) with zero processing fees.
preorder_page.sec1_desc: Every formula in the UFO LABZ collection is manufactured in limited sterile production runs (Batch 01) to ensure peak ingredient freshness and clinical potency.
preorder_page.sec2_desc: Batch 01 orders begin dispatch in the second week of December 2026. You will receive priority tracking numbers as soon as your package leaves our Swiss facility.
preorder_page.sec3_desc: Your pre-order guarantees your allocation from Batch 01 and locks in your 25% launch savings plus any stack discounts (up to an additional 15% off).
preorder_page.sec4_desc: Simply email support@ufolabz.com with your order number to request an immediate cancellation or modification.

privacy_page.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy_page.subtitle: Your privacy is crucial to us. Learn how we handle your personal data in compliance with Swiss nLPD/DSG and GDPR.
privacy_page.sec1_desc: We collect information to process orders and improve your experience: identity data (name, email), transaction data (shipping address), securely tokenized payment info via Stripe, and technical cookies.
privacy_page.sec2_desc: We process your data under Swiss Data Protection Laws (DSG/nLPD) and GDPR to execute purchase contracts, deliver your orders, and provide customer support.
privacy_page.sec3_desc: We never sell your data. We share only with essential operational partners: Swiss Post / DHL for delivery, Stripe for payment processing, and Supabase for secure cloud storage.
privacy_page.sec4_desc: You have the right to access, rectify, or request deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting privacy@ufolabz.com.

terms_page.title: TERMS OF SERVICE
terms_page.subtitle: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before utilizing our orbital platform.
terms_page.sec1_desc: This website is operated by UFO LABZ, Switzerland. All contractual relations are governed exclusively under Swiss Law. The place of jurisdiction is Zurich, Switzerland.
terms_page.sec2_desc: By placing an order via our online platform, you present a binding offer to purchase the selected supplements. The contract is executed upon confirmation of dispatch.
terms_page.sec3_desc: Prices are displayed in CHF (with 8.1% Swiss VAT included) or EUR. Payments are processed securely via Stripe. Pre-orders are charged upon placement to guarantee allocation.
terms_page.sec4_desc: Products are shipped from Switzerland. Risk passes to the consumer upon handover to the postal carrier.

refund_page.title: REFUND & RETURNS POLICY
refund_page.subtitle: Please review our refund parameters. 100% refund guarantee prior to dispatch; hygienic final sale upon delivery.
refund_page.box_desc: For all pre-order reservations (Batch 01), you are entitled to cancel your pre-order at any time prior to shipment dispatch for a 100% full refund with zero fees. Email support@ufolabz.com to cancel instantly.
refund_page.sec1_desc: Once an order has been dispatched and delivered, dietary supplements are final sale due to health, safety, and hygiene standards.
refund_page.sec2_desc: If a product arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, contact us within 14 days of delivery with photos for an immediate free replacement or full refund.
